scope: SDK-independent decode of the 1.4.3.0 assets Frosty could not read, plus the camera-recoil survey. Layout only; field names are hashes and semantics are not decoded.

method.principle: Every class size, alignment, field offset and field type comes from the build's own SharedTypeDescriptors.ebx. The BF6 SDK is not used, so a changed type cannot be read with stale offsets.
method.whyFrostyFailed: EbxReaderRiff resolves a top-level instance by class GUID, and in BF6 that GUID is the type GUID's last 12 bytes plus a 4-byte layout signature. A layout change moves the GUID, the stale SDK has no entry, TypeLibrary.GetType(guid) returns null and the exporter writes a placeholder comment.
method.rejectedAlternative: Patching Frosty to fall back to the type name was rejected: for the 69 types whose layout really changed, the SDK's stale offsets would yield plausible but wrong values with no error.
method.sdkConstraint: BF6SDK.dll cannot be regenerated locally because SDK generation reads the running game process and EA anticheat blocks it.

validation.source: random 1.4.2.5 raw EBX with existing Frosty XML
validation.supersetExplanation: Fields present in the descriptor but absent from the SDK class. Frosty reads and discards them because there is no CLR property to store them on.
validation.disagreementExplanation: All 14 are type names with more than one layout entry. This reader follows the layout the asset declares through its own type key; Frosty follows the SDK's. Such objects are tagged $layoutAmbiguous. Which is correct per asset is not settled.
validation.limit: Using the same decoder on both builds does not resolve competing layouts. Differences and apparent equality in ambiguous objects remain provisional until independently verified.
validation.warningScope: The original decoder marked only top-level ambiguous types. The 2026-09-16 correction also marks ambiguous nested/inherited layouts and their containing objects. Original validation counts have not been reclassified under that warning rule.

pictureInPicture.change: Class_e312e661 gained a 20th field Field_0d48404d, absent in 1.4.2.5, now holding an import of Common/GameSetup/Options/Graphics/OptionEnablePiPZoom.
pictureInPicture.conclusion: The saved decode reports a new OptionEnablePiPZoom reference and no changed numeric fields in the 27 controllers. All 27 comparisons are marked layoutAmbiguous; this is provisional layout evidence, not proof of unchanged zoom, ADS, or runtime behavior.
pictureInPicture.relatedString: Enable or disable Picture in Picture when using certain scopes

attachmentMetadata.structuralChange: Class_535682be restructured; the Field_45422b18 sub-struct moved, and Field_c39698a3 moved from 0xffffffff to a small integer in 241 of 248.
attachmentMetadata.conclusion: The saved decode reports removal of fixed magnification and fire-mode labels. Independent 2026-09-16 comparison of recorded attachment label and description IDs against both English strings tables found no text changes or removed IDs. Matching string-reference sets alone does not prove unchanged wording or field roles.
attachmentMetadata.attachmentBugConsequence: docs/ATTACHMENT_BUGS.md entries 8, 9 and 10 describe wording that is unchanged in 1.4.3.0, so those description bugs stand.

cameraRecoilSurvey.field: Struct_b1f8b400.Field_bbbfe9cc, active only where Field_bbffe8bc is True
cameraRecoilSurvey.ladderNote: Read from the single-zoom GCR_<zoom>_P00 assets. Strictly monotonic in magnification.

su230.reading: Field_7f1bb9d4 held 10 where its paired field already held the correct 1.00x ladder value of -0.5. 10 is far outside the whole ladder, whose maximum is 0.762266 at 10x. 1.4.3.0 brings it onto the ladder.
su230.direction: The operator reports the SU-230 had far too little camera shake before the fix. With the ladder running -0.5 at 1x up to 0.762266 at 10x, that implies a higher value means less camera shake. The unit is not decoded; the direction rests on the in-game observation plus the ladder's shape.

criteria: active override outside the ladder range
scan.conclusion: The SU-230 was the only camera-recoil asset with this defect. Every other optic's members sit on the ladder value for their magnification, across the multi-zoom LPVO, magnifier, variable and SVO families. No other optic currently has lower camera shake than its magnification calls for.

interdictorDamageForSite.pairEncoding: Field_3901db14 is distance, Field_42fc0f5e is damage at that distance.
interdictorDamageForSite.note: The asset stores the curve twice, as a point list and a flat array. In 1.4.2.5 the two disagreed on the fourth distance (170 vs 175; the site used 175). In 1.4.3.0 both agree on 180.
